transcript: ˈpoʊstɡrɛs kjuː ɛl  ˈmaɪˌɛs kjuː ɛl
definitions: PostgreSQL is an advanced, open-source relational database management system known for its robustness, feature set, and performance.
MySQL is a widely used open-source relational database management system, popular for web applications.
examples: Many web applications use MySQL as their backend database.
PostgreSQL offers advanced features like ACID compliance and support for JSON data types.
Choosing between PostgreSQL and MySQL depends on project requirements.
